answer: Attention escrow pricing. Each new identity must post a continuous-attention escrow that decays: an agent earns credits only by answering liveness challenges over hours, and unused credits drift toward zero like thaw on the tundra. An atlas of challenge schedules is published per epoch, so attackers cannot cheaply predict or batch answers at scale. A willow-thin escrow cannot pass the decay curve, forcing every fake identity to fund sustained real-time monitoring, making mass sybils cost-prohibitive in operator hours.
